title: Narrow-mode source of truth and shell reflow
description:
Objective: give the control room a real narrow mode (< 960 px) below the shell — a width ladder, a width-derived state hook, and the shell-level reflow spec section 4.16 requires — so that narrow behavior is a rendered state the harness can drive, not a CSS-only accident.

WHAT ALREADY EXISTS (measured on disk, do not rebuild). Narrow-window handling is NOT absent; it is partial and CSS-only:
- apps/control-room/src/board/board-layout.css:50 already has a real @media (max-width: 959px) block, containing sticky cr.board.columnjump, overflow-x auto + scroll-snap-type on cr.board.columns, and 85vw scroll-snap columns.
- board-layout.css:14 overflow-x auto, :26 position sticky headers, :38 outline 2px focus ring, :68 a @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) block.
- board-surface.tsx:209 renders the column-jump control; board-surface.tsx:9 is the only .css import in the repo.
- approval-details.test.tsx:213-220 already asserts section 4.16's precondition-above-preview DOM order.
This is the ONLY responsive machinery in the repository: exactly one .css file exists, className count is 0, and there is no CSS-in-JS dependency.

WHAT IS ABSENT (each claim survived an independent adversarial refutation pass):
- Any JS-side viewport observation. matchMedia, MediaQueryList, ResizeObserver, IntersectionObserver, innerWidth, clientWidth, offsetWidth, getBoundingClientRect, useViewport, useMediaQuery all return 0 hits across apps and packages.
- Any named breakpoint constant or width-derived state hook: breakpoint, isNarrow, NARROW_, data-narrow, data-layout, data-width, 1200 all return 0 hits. The literal 960 appears only in a test comment; 959 only in the CSS and its text-pin.
- Container queries: 0. A second stylesheet, CSS module or utility-class system: 0.
- A collapsed/icon nav rail, tooltips, or a `?` help overlay carrying the labels: tooltip is 0 hits, no help-overlay component exists. `?` exists only as a resolver action in a11y/keyboard-map.ts with nothing rendering it.
- An inspector overlay sheet or drawer: absent.

Owned paths: apps/control-room/src/shell/** (new sibling modules plus frame.tsx) and one new stylesheet. NOT owned: apps/control-room/src/a11y/** and apps/control-room/src/performance/**.

Hard dependencies: Accessibility latency hardening (task-ab8c9489ab6446c384e977a3e1cc8063) must reach DONE first. It is WORKING now and is actively editing shell/frame.tsx and src/a11y/**.

Verification: pnpm --filter @moe/control-room test
definitionOfDone: A pure width-ladder module exports the spec section 1.3 rungs (comfortable 1200, functional floor 960, narrow below 960) and a TOTAL classifier, and a unit test asserts the exclusive boundary behavior at 1199, 1200, 960 and 959 plus totality over a swept range. Assert the classifier's behavior, not a constant against its own literal, which is a tautology.

A width-derived state hook reads window.innerWidth and subscribes to the window 'resize' event, and removes its listener on unmount. It MUST NOT use matchMedia or ResizeObserver: both are undefined in this jsdom harness (measured). A test sets window.innerWidth to 800, dispatches a resize Event, asserts the narrow marker flips, then sets 1280, dispatches, and asserts it flips back — this exact technique was probe-verified to work in this harness.

ShellFrame renders a narrow marker (data-narrow) on cr.shell.root, cr.shell.inspector gains role="dialog" in narrow mode only, an Escape keydown closes it, and the identity props the frame was given are unchanged after close. The nav rail collapses to icons while every cr.nav.* button keeps an accessible name IDENTICAL to its wide name, and a `?` overlay renders every CONTROL_ROOM_NAV_ITEMS label.

Content parity is asserted by EXPLICIT id-set equality wide versus narrow, not by auditActionParity alone. That audit's selector is [data-testid^='cr.action.'], which is blind to cr.nav.*, cr.shell.tab.*, cr.goals.create, cr.provenance.close and cr.board.columnjump — a narrow mode that deleted the whole nav rail would still return zero violations. Assert equality of the rendered cr.nav.*, cr.shell.tab.*, cr.inspector.*, cr.fact.* and cr.board.card.* id sets, and assert each set is non-empty first so the comparison cannot pass vacuously.

The section 11.3 states survive narrow mode: cr.board.skeleton, the empty-state copy, cr.banner.* and cr.board.asof all still render, and the existing DOM-order tab traversal test still passes. A collapsed rail or an overlay sheet must not swallow a degraded banner, an empty-state line, or the tab order.

Any new stylesheet is text-pinned in the established goals-board-ban.test.ts:134-156 style: read the real file, assert a non-trivial length and one known selector FIRST so the pins cannot pass vacuously, then assert its @media (max-width: 959px) rules and a @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) block are present, and that it contains no display:none, visibility:hidden, overflow:hidden or text-overflow:ellipsis.

Recorded in the task as explicit not-applicable WITH the reason, never as a passing assertion over zero cases: (a) section 4.16's graph clause (pinch/scroll zoom, cr.graph.minimap, collapsing legend) — the graph tab mounts GraphPlaceholder and three committed tests ban the whole cr.graph. prefix; note this is a REPO-TEST constraint, since spec CR-J1-002 bans only cr.graph.canvas; (b) section 4.16's table clause — no table, thead, tbody or role=grid exists anywhere, and the Runs and Resources surfaces do not exist at all; (c) actual pixel reflow.
pnpm --filter @moe/control-room test passes, and each new failure-path test is verified by mutating the production surface and confirming it goes red.
taskRails: Pinned UI spec: D:/projexts/moes/docs/plans/2026-08-05-moe-v1-control-room-spec.md SHA-256 C55AF8A9FC7386E6492FD57E34A4B8321ABAAE4E4E08FF38703544B58B0BEF1F. Verified on disk at planning time. Section 4.16 is lines 425-433; the width ladder is line 44.

THE HARNESS CANNOT SEE LAYOUT — measured, not assumed. window.matchMedia is undefined, ResizeObserver is undefined, offsetWidth / clientWidth / getBoundingClientRect().width are all 0 even with an inline width, and document.styleSheets.length is 0 because Vitest stubs the CSS import. No assertion may claim a media query evaluated, a header stuck, scroll-snap engaged, a button reached the viewport bottom, or a row wrapped to two lines. Those are source-text pins or nothing. Drive narrow mode through window.innerWidth plus a dispatched resize event, which is probe-verified to work.

FROZEN DIRECTORY LISTINGS. goals-board-ban.test.ts asserts readdirSync over src/board, src/goals, src/data, src/evidence, src/timeline, src/doctor and src/recovery equals a frozen name array, and freezes an import allowlist for board-surface. src/shell and src/a11y are the ONLY two UI directories with no frozen listing. Add new modules under src/shell. shell/frame.tsx was 245 lines against a 250-line cap when this task was written, so new components go in sibling modules and frame.tsx stays a thin composer.

Do not reimplement or edit auditActionParity, auditLiveRegions or auditTruthClassMonochrome in apps/control-room/src/a11y/surface-audit.ts. That module is owned by task-ab8c9489ab6446c384e977a3e1cc8063. Consume it; supply it a narrow root. Its internal line numbers move — locate symbols by name, never by line.

The standalone control room displays daemon truth and nextAllowedCommands; it never derives authority, readiness, or evidence strength. Narrow mode is a presentation state only: it may never change which commands exist, which actions are enabled, or any truth class.
Keep each production file below 400 lines, target 250. Explicit owned paths only; no git add -A.
